headline: Copper Price Drops to Lowest Level Since March as AI Capex Concerns Surge
summary: Three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange dropped 1.7% to $12,310.50 per metric ton, heading for its largest weekly decline in 19 months. The industrial metal hit an intraday low of $12,202 as tech sector capital investment expectations cooled.
why: Copper is used extensively in electrical wiring, power grids, industrial machinery, and data center infrastructure, making it a proxy for global economic activity.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Waning investment appetite in technology infrastructure sectors dampened demand forecasts for refined copper.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global profit-taking in technology and AI sectors reduced industrial demand sentiment for refined copper metal.
